## Primary clinical sources

- Ben Ayed 2009, PMID 19522426:
  https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19522426/
  Abstract: 32 equally allocated; 62.5% vs 37.5%; repeated cycles mentioned.
  No complete original raw-count table was independently acquired.
- Moll 2006, PMID 16769748 / PMC1482338:
  https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC1482338/
  Original full HTML: Table 2 (71/111 vs 82/114 ovulation); Results narrative
  (18 vs 6 side-effect discontinuations). Table 4 is per-protocol and was NOT
  substituted for the primary trial-wide counts. Direct refetch sometimes hit
  reCAPTCHA; original indexed HTML was readable through search retrieval.
- Vandermolen 2001, PMID 11172832:
  https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11172832/
  Original abstract: participant ovulation counts 9/12 versus 4/15; distinguish
  from the separately reported conception counts.
- Legro 2007, PMID 17287476 / DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa063971:
  https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa063971
  Original full HTML: randomised three-group design; 209/208/209 participants;
  Results narrative gives no documented ovulation in 52 clomiphene, 93 metformin,
  35 combination participants. At-least-one-ovulation counts/OR are auditor
  complements. The reported cycle-rate model uses repeated-measure correlation;
  its cycles are NOT treated as independent people here.
- IVF studies: PMID 21917254 and 21982727:
  https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21917254/
  https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21982727/
  Original publications identify the gonadotropin/IVF setting; family linkage
  was inspected in the pinned review.
- Kazerooni 2009, PMID 19552904 (RETRACTED):
  https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19552904/
  Retraction notice, 24 September 2026, PMID 42781833:
  https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42781833/
  DOI https://doi.org/10.1002/ijgo.71389
  Notice's own abstract read through indexed PubMed retrieval. Direct open
  attempts also failed; those failures were not treated as absence of a notice.
- Sample source records:
  https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28118681/
  https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19692630/
  https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42002670/
- Broad 2019 comparator review, PMID 31845767:
  https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31845767/
  Overall review and relevant add-on-to-clomiphene subset are not the same set.

These are source-verification notes, not a licence/admission determination.
No full clinical papers or PDFs are redistributed in this archive.
